name: @greek-postal-code-db/typescript
description: Read-only Node.js and Bun client for Greek postal-code data

scripts.build: copyfiles -u 1 ../library.sqlite data/ && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --sourcemap && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && node --test test/contract.test.mjs && bun test test/contract.test.mjs
